name: ClearView Unified Buffer Construction
definition: Preprocessing technique that converts a hexahedral mesh (positions, connectivity, scalars) into four GPU-friendly texture buffers (vertices, edges, faces, cellScalar) for the ClearView volume rendering pipeline.
summary: ClearView Unified Buffer Construction converts hexahedral meshes into four GPU-friendly 2D texture buffers for efficient volume rendering, distinguishing itself by mapping topology into linearized 2D layouts rather than standard 3D textures.
